title: Hybrid Gaussian Representation with Geometry-Guided Constraints for High-Precision 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering--Hybrid Gaussian Splatting with Geometry Guidance--Adaptive Hybrid Representation and TensoSDF Constraints for High-Accuracy Real-Time 3D Reconstruction and Rendering
abstract: In recent years, 3D Gaussian splatting has achieved significant progress as an efficient rasterization rendering method in real-time 3D reconstruction and rendering. However, existing methods still face limitations in terms of geometric accuracy, material realism, and adaptability to complex scenes, particularly in balancing the representation of planar and thin structures, achieving global geometric consistency, and optimizing specular reflection performance. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a high-precision 3D Gaussian splatting rendering method that integrates hybrid Gaussian representations with geometry-guided techniques. The method adaptively selects 2D or 3D Gaussian splatting within a unified rendering pipeline to enhance the representation efficiency of planar and volumetric structures. It combines TensoSDF geometry guidance to achieve efficient implicit surface constraints and global geometric consistency through tensor decomposition. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the original 3DGS in terms of rendering quality and geometric accuracy across multiple benchmark datasets, while maintaining high training and rendering efficiency. It is applicable to diverse scenarios, including architectural reconstruction, vegetation rendering, human modeling, and real-time interaction.
